tray.tooltip: Catail — take a screenshot with PrintScreen

overlay.hint: Drag to select an area · Esc: cancel
overlay.create_queue_title: Start a new queue with this selection. While there is a queue, Ctrl+V pastes it all in order.
overlay.mode_screenshot_title: Select an area and take a screenshot
overlay.mode_text_title: Turn on text mode: from now on everything you copy with Ctrl+C joins the queue, and Ctrl+V pastes it all in order.
overlay.mode_text_on_title: Text mode is on. Click to turn it off.
overlay.read_text_title: Recognize the text in the selection (offline)
overlay.qr_copy_text: Copy the text in the QR code

notify.hotkey_failed_body: {shortcut} may be in use by another app.
notify.snipping_title: PrintScreen is taken by the Windows Snipping Tool
notify.snipping_body: In Settings → Accessibility → Keyboard, turn off "Use the Print screen key to open Snipping Tool", then restart Catail.
notify.queue_add_failed: Couldn't add the image to the queue: {error}
notify.queue_empty: The queue is empty. Select an area with PrintScreen and press "Start a queue", or pick "Text mode" at the top.
notify.paste_cancelled: Pasting stopped: {done}/{total} items pasted. The queue is kept.
notify.release_keys: The shortcut keys weren't released, so pasting was cancelled.
notify.update_available_body: Catail {version} is ready. Install it from Settings → Updates.

settings.title: Catail Settings
settings.shortcut_fullscreen: Capture the full screen (the one with the cursor)
settings.shortcut_ctrl_v: Paste the queue while there is one
settings.hotkey_help: Click a shortcut and press the new keys to change it. Ctrl+Alt on its own (clashes with AltGr), Ctrl+C/V/X/Z/Y/A and single letters can't be used.
settings.hotkey_altgr: {shortcut}: Ctrl+Alt on its own clashes with AltGr on many keyboards; add Shift or Win.
settings.hotkey_reserved: {shortcut} is one of the apps' own shortcuts, like copy and paste.
settings.hotkey_needs_modifier: {shortcut}: a single key would block typing everywhere; add Ctrl, Alt or Win.
settings.hotkey_taken: {shortcut} is used by another program; the previous shortcuts were kept.
settings.paste_mode_auto_help: Images only: all at once (or as the app rule says). Text only: joined together. A mixed queue: one item at a time.
settings.paste_mode_batch_help: Images always go as one file list and texts joined together, in a single paste.
settings.paste_mode_sequential_help: Each item is put on the clipboard and pasted on its own. Slower, but works in every app; Esc stops it.
settings.sequential_delay: Pause between items when pasting one by one (ms)
settings.batch_restore_delay: Wait before restoring the clipboard after pasting all at once (ms)
settings.send_enter: Press Enter between texts (sends each text as its own message in chat apps)
settings.app_rules_help: Pick one-by-one pasting for apps that only take the first image of a batch. Write the program name as Task Manager shows it (e.g. whatsapp.exe).
settings.printscreen_note: If PrintScreen opens the Windows Snipping Tool: go to Settings → Accessibility → Keyboard, turn off "Use the Print screen key to open Snipping Tool" and restart Catail (tray → Quit, then open it again).
settings.update_installing: Downloading and installing; the app will restart…
settings.update_error: Couldn't reach the update server. Check your internet connection or try again later.

badge.undo_paste_title: Bring the {count} pasted items back into the queue
badge.undo_clear_title: Bring the {count} removed items back into the queue

panel.title: Queue · {count} items
panel.paste_title: Paste the queue into the app you just used
panel.export_zip: Images as PNG, texts as TXT

ocr.no_language: Windows has no language pack for text recognition. Add one under Settings → Time & language → Language.
ocr.title: Recognized text
ocr.nothing: No text found in this area.

preview.save_failed: Couldn't save. The item may have left the queue.
